settings.title: Settings
settings.keepRecordingsHint: The recording stays on your phone for thirteen months, then it’s gone. The text of the entry stays for good.
settings.forgetBody: All saved voice recordings will be deleted. Your journal entries will stay.
onboarding.welcomeBody: Talk about whatever worried you, made you happy, or upset you today. Vidlun helps you sort through your emotions, put a name to them, and better understand how you’re feeling.
onboarding.privacyOnDevice: Your audio and text are stored only on your phone. Vidlun doesn’t keep them on its servers.
onboarding.micBody: For that, Vidlun needs access to your microphone.
onboarding.legalNote: By tapping “Next,” you agree to the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.
settings.themeHint: “Same as phone” turns dark in the evening along with your phone. A theme you pick stays as is.
processing.hint: Recognizing your words and looking for the key emotions. This takes a few seconds.
processing.still: Still working on it. The connection is slow.

turn.hint: You can pick one emotion or a few.

ground.offerFact: Try noticing what’s around you right now. It’s a short grounding exercise — nothing is recorded or saved.
ground.hint1: Find 5 things you can see. Tap the circle for each one.
ground.hint2: Notice 4 sounds around you. Tap the circle for each one.
ground.hint3: Notice 3 sensations on your skin. Tap the circle for each one.
ground.ring: Tap when you notice one. {{n}} of {{total}}
ground.leaveBody: You can come back to it anytime in the Me section.
ground.endBreath: Take one more slow breath in and out.
ground.endReturn: You can come back to this exercise whenever you want to pause and be in the moment.
